recipe.design: Original compact residential top-freezer refrigerator with two enamel doors, visible gasket seams, vertical pull handles, feet, side pressings, rear condenser coil, restrained deterministic paint wear.
recipe.source_inputs: No external meshes, textures, reference pixels, or downloaded art. Geometry and materials are generated by this repository's Blender Python recipe.
recipe.origin: center of cabinet footprint at floor level; Blender Z-up
recipe.dimension_note: Recipe proportions are metric-like design values, not F12-certified world scale. Godot's current house grid has no documented meter calibration.

placement.collision_shape: proposed axis-aligned box for the main cabinet body; not exported as visible geometry
placement.visual_clearance_note: Door pulls protrude beyond the cabinet depth and are not represented in this coarse blocking volume. Validate clearance and collision separately in the actual Godot room.

godot_contract_observed.grid: One house coordinate unit projects to 40x20 screen pixels (2:1); no meter conversion is declared.
godot_contract_observed.furniture_collision: Current furniture blocks movement through Rect2(item.pos, item.size).grow(player_radius), not imported GLB collision.
godot_contract_observed.integration: Candidate must not be added to main.tscn, scripts/house.gd, or production gameplay by this work order.

diagnostic_render.framing: Orthographic, fixed candidate world scale, transparent RGBA; this is diagnostic and not independent F12 certification.

rights.source_code: Original procedural recipe, written for this work order.
rights.license_status: No third-party art is included. Founder/legal rights review remains unresolved; no external research pixels or geometry were used.
